title: Vitamin D test
what: A blood test from a vein. It shows how much vitamin D is stored in your body.
why: For weakness, bone pain, frequent fractures, or osteoporosis, or when you take vitamin D, to choose the right dose.
duration: the blood draw usually takes 5 minutes
tell_doctor: If you take vitamin D or multivitamins, and what dose
If you take supplements with biotin. They can change some test results
If you have kidney, liver, or bowel disease

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: The test is usually done in the morning on an empty stomach, or 3 to 4 hours after eating. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Vitamins
prepare.text: Do not stop taking vitamin D on your own before the test. Tell your doctor what you take. The doctor decides.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: You sit down, and your arm rests on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow
The skin is wiped with alcohol, and blood is taken from a vein
The needle is removed, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick needle prick for a couple of seconds
after: Keep the cotton pad pressed for a few minutes
Results usually come in 1 to 3 days
Your doctor will explain what the numbers mean

faq.q: Do I need to fast for a vitamin D test?
faq.a: Strict fasting is usually not required. But many labs ask you to come in the morning on an empty stomach, or 3 to 4 hours after eating.

faq.q: Can I take vitamin D without a test?
faq.a: A preventive dose is often given without a test. A treatment dose is best chosen with your doctor, based on the test.
